build/editorial/L05.json.kicker.en: For sale, tenanted · Exclusive · Tzukei Aviv, north Tel Aviv
build/editorial/L05.json.dek.en: A furnished, fully equipped apartment in a Tzukei Aviv boutique building, let at NIS 15,000 a month: a 3.6% gross yield on a price of NIS 5,000,000, with two parking spaces and a storage room.
build/editorial/L05.json.story.en[0]: 3.5 rooms, furnished and equipped down to the kitchenware and the towels, in a nine-floor boutique building on Eliyahu Berlin Street.[[S86,S4]] The apartment is let at NIS 15,000 a month, and the price is NIS 5,000,000.[[S85,S4]]
build/editorial/L05.json.story.en[1]: About 90 sqm built with a 12 sqm balcony, on floor 3 of 9, in a building from 2022.[[S84,S4]] The layout includes a generous master suite and an equipped kitchen, and the apartment looks out to an open view. Two parking spaces and a storage room are attached.[[S93]]
build/editorial/L05.json.story.en[2]: The management fee is NIS 600 a month, and the building has a designed lobby and a new gym.[[S87]] The possible vacating date and the terms of the lease are given in writing before signing, and they decide whether the apartment suits an investor or a buyer who means to live in it.
build/editorial/L05.json.features.en[5][1]: On foot to Tel Baruch beach and the promenade
build/editorial/L05.json.numbers.lead.en: The price and the current rent, computed against the tax and lending rules published up to 16 September 2026.
build/editorial/L05.json.numbers.ledger[5].note.en: 102 sqm including the balcony at 2026 newest-code rates, zones 2 and 1; zone to be confirmed
build/editorial/L05.json.faq[0].a.en: At the current rent of NIS 15,000 a month, the gross yield is 3.60% on NIS 5,000,000. If the landlord pays the management fee it is 3.46%, and under the 10% rental tax track 3.24%.[[S84,S67]]
build/editorial/L05.json.faq[1].a.en: Vacating is flexible.[[S84]] Obtain the lease end date and the tenant's position in writing before making an offer.
build/editorial/L05.json.faq[2].a.en: The apartment is furnished and equipped, including kitchenware and towels.[[S86]] Attach an inventory and its condition to the contract, and ask a lawyer how the value of the furniture is handled in the filing to the Tax Authority.
build/editorial/L05.json.faq[4].a.en: The same building also offers an unfurnished 3-room apartment at NIS 4,650,000.[[S1]] The NIS 350,000 gap reflects the furniture, the sitting tenant and an extra half room.
build/editorial/L05.json.seo.en.desc: Furnished 3.5 rooms in a boutique building on Eliyahu Berlin Street, let at NIS 15,000 a month. NIS 5,000,000, 3.6% gross yield, taxes and comps.

build/editorial/L06.json.kicker.en: For rent · Exclusive · Tzukei Aviv, north Tel Aviv
build/editorial/L06.json.dek.en: A double-height living space and glass walls facing the sea, on floor 8 of 9 in a new boutique building: five rooms plus a safe room on about 184 sqm, and a balcony of about 20 sqm. NIS 27,000 a month, with a year paid upfront.
build/editorial/L06.json.story.en[0]: Here the sea is part of the architecture: a living space about six to seven metres high with glass walls facing the water, on floor 8 of 9 in a new boutique building on Eliyahu Berlin Street.[[S92,S7]] The apartment is new from the developer and has never been lived in.[[S7]]
build/editorial/L06.json.story.en[1]: Five rooms plus a safe room on about 184 sqm, with a sun balcony of about 20 sqm facing the sea. The specification includes underfloor heating, concealed appliances, Exclusive light fittings, a Häcker kitchen and precise joinery.[[S90,S92]]
build/editorial/L06.json.story.en[2]: The rent is NIS 27,000 a month on the condition of a year paid upfront, and the building fee is NIS 1,400 a month.[[S89,S92,S7]] The building has a formal lobby and a new gym, and the beach is about five to seven minutes on foot.[[S90]]
build/editorial/L06.json.features.en[1][1]: Five rooms plus a safe room
build/editorial/L06.json.numbers.lead.en: The rent, computed against 2026 rates and the published lease rules.
build/editorial/L06.json.numbers.tabs[0].rows[2].note.en: 184 sqm at the over-140 sqm rate, zone 2 to zone 1; zone to be confirmed
build/editorial/L06.json.faq[0].a.en: The rent is NIS 27,000 on the condition of a year paid upfront, and the payments field is marked flexible.[[S92,S7]] Monthly payment is arranged directly with Meital Katzir.
build/editorial/L06.json.faq[3].a.en: The no-brokerage offer applied to leases closed in August 2026.[[S92]] Customary brokerage is one month plus VAT, about NIS 31,860 here.[[G_NBN_RENT]]
build/editorial/L06.json.faq[4].a.en: About five to seven minutes on foot to Tel Baruch beach and the coastal park promenade.[[S89,S90]]

build/editorial/L07.json.kicker.en: For sale · Exclusive · Kochav HaTzafon, north Tel Aviv
build/editorial/L07.json.dek.en: One floor below the top, in a new boutique building in Kochav HaTzafon: five rooms on about 190 sqm, and beside them 80 sqm of terraces that open onto the Tel Aviv skyline. NIS 18,000,000.
build/editorial/L07.json.story.en[0]: A new mini penthouse on floor 11 of 12, in a boutique building in Kochav HaTzafon, the neighborhood between Yarkon Park and Ramat Aviv.[[S1,S2,S6]] Five rooms on about 190 sqm built, with terraces totaling 76 to 80 sqm and open views across Tel Aviv.[[S43,S44]] The price is NIS 18,000,000.[[S1,S2]]
build/editorial/L07.json.story.en[1]: The plan includes a generous master suite, a children's wing with a sea-view balcony, a large living room and an equipped kitchen with a concealed integrated refrigerator. Custom joinery runs through the home, and the air conditioning is a VRF multi-split system.[[S43,S44,S50]] Two parking spaces, a storage room, a safe room and a lift come with the apartment.[[S1,S2]]
build/editorial/L07.json.story.en[2]: The building has a residents' gym.[[S43]] At the edge of the neighborhood, a pedestrian and cycle bridge of about 170 m from Levi Eshkol Street into Yarkon Park has been under construction since summer 2026 and is expected to open in 2027.[[S7]]
build/editorial/L07.json.features.en[1][1]: Five rooms and a generous master suite
build/editorial/L07.json.features.en[4][1]: A safe room and a lift
build/editorial/L07.json.building_lead.en: The building's address, the developer and the management fee are given on direct request.
build/editorial/L07.json.location.en[0]: Kochav HaTzafon is bounded by Rokach Boulevard and Yarkon Park to the south, Namir Road to the east, Shai Agnon Street and the Sde Dov district to the north, and Ibn Gabirol to the west.[[S6]] It was built mostly in the 1990s and 2000s as 8 to 12-floor blocks around a central park, alongside residential towers and boutique buildings.[[S4,S46]] Data published by Mako put its median deal from 2023 to October 2025 at NIS 6.1 million, the fourth highest in Israel.[[S31]]
build/editorial/L07.json.numbers.lead.en: The price of NIS 18,000,000, computed against the tax and lending rules published up to 16 September 2026.
build/editorial/L07.json.numbers.ledger[2].note.en: 190 sqm in zone 2 up to 270 sqm including terraces in zone 1, at the over-140 sqm rate. The zone and the way open terraces are charged are to be confirmed.
build/editorial/L07.json.market.h2.en: The price against the market in Kochav HaTzafon
build/editorial/L07.json.faq[3].a.en: The Sde Dov district is rising to the north, with towers of 20 to 45 floors in the center plan, and three 28-floor towers are planned at Rokach and Namir.[[S15,S11]] Some open views in the neighborhood are expected to be blocked.[[S5]]

build/editorial/L08.json.kicker.en: For sale · Exclusive · Migdalei Ne'eman, north Tel Aviv
build/editorial/L08.json.dek.en: Facing the landscaped gardens of Migdalei Ne'eman, about two minutes on foot from Tzuk beach: 4.5 rooms plus a separate safe room on about 130 sqm, inside a complex with a covered pool, a spa and a lobby guard around the clock. NIS 5,900,000.
build/editorial/L08.json.story.en[0]: The apartment faces the landscaped gardens of the complex: 4.5 rooms plus a separate safe room on about 130 sqm, on floor 1 of 8, with three exposures, two parking spaces and a storage room.[[S1,S43]] It is well kept, available for immediate entry, and the price is NIS 5,900,000.[[S1]]
build/editorial/L08.json.story.en[1]: Migdalei Ne'eman is a complex of 330 apartments in seven buildings on Michael Ne'eman Street, next to Tzuk beach, occupied in stages between 2000 and 2015.[[S3,S10,S11]] Residents have a covered pool open all year, a spa with a sauna and a jacuzzi, a gym, lawns and a lobby guard 24 hours a day.[[S3,S8,S10]] The building facades carry mosaics by the artist Yaacov Agam.[[S10]]
build/editorial/L08.json.story.en[2]: The complex fee covers the maintenance and the use of all the facilities, and was reported in 2024 at about NIS 2,300 a month for a 138 sqm apartment.[[S3]] The sea and Tzuk beach are about two minutes away on foot.[[S43]]
build/editorial/L08.json.building_lead.en: Which phase of the complex built this building, and the year it was occupied, are given on direct request.
build/editorial/L08.json.location.en[0]: The complex sits in northern Tzukei Aviv, the neighborhood between Unitzman Street, Namir Road, Propes Street and the sea.[[S45]] The management company places it next to Tzuk beach, and the street is filed under the Glilot area in some records.[[S10,S19]]
build/editorial/L08.json.numbers.lead.en: The price, computed against the tax and lending rules published up to 16 September 2026.
build/editorial/L08.json.numbers.bars.note.en: All bars share one scale. The room counts and floors in the recorded sales were read automatically and should be checked on the Tax Authority site.
build/editorial/L08.json.market.lead.en: Sales and listings on Michael Ne'eman Street and nearby complexes, plus market data. The recorded sales were read automatically and should be confirmed before negotiating.
build/editorial/L08.json.faq[2].a.en: About two minutes on foot to the sea and Tzuk beach.[[S43]] A rental listing by another advertiser in the complex says five minutes.[[S26]]
